verdict.rationale: First-party docs show SigNoz ingests traces, logs, and metrics into one OpenTelemetry-native platform, and that it derives APM metrics from traces. Pivoting is also documented: logs can be correlated with traces and metrics, and any dashboard panel can drill down into its underlying logs and traces. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how shared context works (e.g., trace_id/attribute linking between signals), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the cross-signal pivot workflow.
